title: calamagrostis glacialis
intro: Calamagrostis glacialis, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a type of perennial grass native to high-altitude regions in the Northern Hemisphere. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Calamagrostis glacialis include its potential to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Calamagrostis glacialis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
